name: Fraud Detection & Caller Authentication
description: Real-time identity verification and fraud prevention layer combining network ANI spoofing telemetry, passive and active voice biometrics, step-up multi-factor authentication (MFA), and account takeover (ATO) threat scoring.
roleInCenter: Trust and identity gatekeeper: verifies genuine customers with minimal friction while intercepting social engineering, voice spoofing, and account takeover attacks before sensitive data or funds are exposed.

glossary.definition: Pre-answer telephony inspection analyzing STIR and SHAKEN attestation, carrier origin, VoIP aggregator hops, and virtual number velocity to spot forged caller IDs
Background acoustic voiceprint verification that authenticates a caller during natural conversation within seconds without requiring a fixed passphrase
Acoustic spectral analyzer that detects replay attacks, voice clones, and text-to-speech artifacts in the incoming audio stream
Security risk inherent in static personal questions such as mother's maiden name or date of birth that fraudsters easily harvest from data breaches
Risk-triggered out-of-band verification challenge such as an authenticated mobile app push, FIDO passkey, or cryptographic OTP required before high-risk actions
Multi-signal defense stopping bad actors from hijacking customer credentials, SIM-swapping phone numbers, or socially engineering agents into resetting access
Gallery of acoustic voiceprints belonging to repeat bad actors used to flag incoming calls across any dialed account in real time
Real-time mobile network query verifying whether the caller's mobile subscriber identity or carrier port status changed recently before trusting SMS factors

facets.name: Authentication Modalities & Assurance Tiers
facets.description: Layered identity verification methods balanced by risk level and customer friction

children.name: Carrier Attestation & Line Intelligence
children.description: STIR and SHAKEN level-A attestation combined with clean SIM tenure

children.name: Enrolled Passive Voiceprint Match
children.description: Continuous acoustic match against the customer's enrolled voice model

children.name: In-App Biometric Session Token
children.description: Cryptographic token passed when call originates from a FaceID or TouchID logged-in mobile app

children.name: Mobile App Push Biometric Approval
children.description: Out-of-band prompt approved inside the customer's registered mobile device

children.name: SIM-Tenure Verified One-Time Passcode
children.description: Time-bound passcode allowed only after passing real-time SIM-swap checks

children.name: FIDO2 & Passkey Challenge
children.description: Phishing-resistant cryptographic verification for high-value wire or profile changes

children.name: Static Demographic KBA
children.description: DOB, postal code, or static security questions vulnerable to breach dumps and social engineering

facets.name: Contact Center Fraud & Threat Vectors
facets.description: Attack patterns targeting IVR self-service and live contact center agents

children.name: ANI Caller ID Spoofing
children.description: Forging the victim's phone number to bypass naive ANI-based CRM lookups

children.name: AI Voice Cloning & Replay Attack
children.description: Using generative TTS voice clones to fool agents or weak voice biometrics

children.name: Multi-Call Pretexting & Reconnaissance
children.description: Harassing multiple agents across repeat calls to harvest partial account clues

children.name: SIM-Swap & MFA Hijack
children.description: Porting victim's mobile number to intercept SMS recovery codes and reset contact center PINs

children.name: Automated IVR PIN Brute-Forcing
children.description: High-velocity automated dialing probing IVR self-service balance and card activation flows

facets.name: Real-Time Fraud Intervention Controls
facets.description: Automated policy responses executed when risk scores cross threshold bands

children.name: Low-Risk Green Fast-Track
children.description: Pre-authenticates caller in IVR and suppresses manual agent security questions

children.name: Medium-Risk Step-Up Gate
children.description: Locks sensitive CRM actions on agent desktop until out-of-band step-up MFA succeeds

children.name: High-Risk Fraud Specialist Divert
children.description: Silently routes suspected ATO or watchlist matches to the specialized fraud investigation queue

metrics.name: Average Authentication Time per Contact
metrics.definition: Mean interaction seconds spent verifying caller identity before issue handling begins

metrics.name: Passive Zero-Friction Authentication Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of eligible inbound callers verified automatically via network, app token, or passive voice biometrics without verbal interrogation

metrics.name: Authenticated Self-Service Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Share of callers completing high-assurance IVR or virtual agent transactions enabled by automated authentication

metrics.name: High-Risk Fraud Alert Escalations
metrics.definition: Volume of inbound contacts flagged for high-priority fraud investigation due to watchlist match, spoofing, or ATO signals

metrics.name: Genuine Caller False Rejection Rate (FRR)
metrics.definition: Percentage of legitimate customers erroneously failed by biometric or network risk checks and forced into manual recovery

failureModes.name: Static KBA Social Engineering Bypass
failureModes.signal: Fraudsters pass verbal security questions using leaked personal data and convince agents to change email or wire funds
failureModes.mitigation: Retire static KBA questions and enforce hard desktop locks requiring cryptographic step-up MFA before profile or payment mutations

failureModes.name: SMS OTP Interception via SIM Swap
failureModes.signal: High-value accounts experience sudden password and phone changes shortly after carrier port-out events
failureModes.mitigation: Query carrier SIM-swap and port-age APIs prior to SMS dispatch; block SMS OTP if SIM changed within 72 hours

failureModes.name: Noisy Environment Biometric False Rejects
failureModes.signal: Legitimate mobile callers in noisy environments repeatedly fail voice verification, spiking AHT and customer frustration
failureModes.mitigation: Check audio SNR prior to biometric scoring and fall back seamlessly to in-app push approval when background noise is high

failureModes.name: Generative Voice Clone Spoofing
failureModes.signal: Synthetic TTS audio replays attempt to pass voiceprint matching on high-balance accounts
failureModes.mitigation: Enable acoustic liveness and synthetic artifact detection alongside multi-signal carrier attestation

scoringModel.name: Zero-Trust Biometric & Fraud Defense Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates identity verification and fraud interception across passive zero-friction biometrics, network and SIM attestation, deepfake liveness defense, and risk-adaptive step-up MFA governance.

stateVariables.description: Continuous Bayesian log-odds trajectory log( P(Fraud | y_0:t) * inv(1 - P(Fraud | y_0:t)) ) updated in real time across telephony, acoustic biometric, and behavioral telemetry
Streaming acoustic log-likelihood ratio comparing incoming caller speech frames against the enrolled customer voiceprint model versus universal background and watchlist models
Continuous spectral phase-continuity and vocal-tract liveness posterior distinguishing organic human speech from generative TTS voice clones and replay attacks
Continuous anomaly score over IVR keypad cadence, conversational hesitation, and social-engineering pretexting script patterns
Risk-adaptive authentication decision boundary trading off False Acceptance Rate (FAR) exposure against genuine-customer False Rejection Rate (FRR) handle-time cost

differentialEquations.name: Continuous Bayesian Fraud Log-Odds Filtering SDE
differentialEquations.formula: dl_fraud(t) = ( w_watch * LLR_watch(t) - w_bio * S_live(t) * LLR_bio(t) + w_deepfake * (1 - S_live(t)) + w_behav * A_behav(t) ) * dt - kappa_mfa * dI_stepup(t) + sigma_obs * dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: Continuously integrates watchlist similarity LLR_watch(t), liveness-weighted voiceprint match S_live(t) * LLR_bio(t), deepfake artifacts (1 - S_live(t)), and behavioral anomalies A_behav(t) from initial carrier prior l_fraud(0), while verified cryptographic step-up MFA dI_stepup(t) applies a downward risk reset

differentialEquations.name: SNR-Weighted Passive Voice Biometric Evidence Accumulation
differentialEquations.formula: dLLR_bio(t) * inv(dt) = phi_snr(SNR_db(t)) * VAD_speech(t) * ( log p(x_acoust(t) | M_enrolled) - log p(x_acoust(t) | M_ubm) )
differentialEquations.interpretation: Accumulates frame-level acoustic evidence only during active speech intervals VAD_speech(t) weighted by signal-to-noise reliability phi_snr(SNR_db(t)), preventing noisy mobile connections from triggering false rejections

differentialEquations.name: Risk-Adaptive FAR and FRR Operating Threshold Control Law
differentialEquations.interpretation: Dynamically positions the step-up and block threshold theta_gate(t) according to the ratio of false-reject customer friction cost (C_frr_aht + C_csat_drop) to the dollar exposure at risk C_ato_loss(V_tx(t)) of the requested transaction

scaleInvariants: Zero-trust mutation invariant: no high-risk CRM or payment tool execution is reachable while l_fraud(t) > theta_gate(t) without cryptographic step-up verification
Sub-3-second passive verification convergence: for SNR > 15 dB, enrolled genuine callers cross the green fast-track boundary l_fraud(t) < theta_green within 3 seconds of natural speech
Neyman-Pearson operating optimality: dynamic threshold theta_gate(t) minimizes expected fraud loss plus AHT friction across all contact volume scales
